name: Gazrog
summary: At the Crossroads, Gazrog keeps watch over the Horde’s roads and supply lines. He calls on passing Horde travelers to face threats in the Barrens and search for lost patrols.

sections.title: A Sentinel of the Crossroads
sections.body: Gazrog watches over the Crossroads and the roads beyond it. Marauders and beasts threaten the supplies moving through this isolated settlement, so he works with its defenders to keep cargo, coin, and couriers moving. The wilderness demands constant attention, and Gazrog depends on passing travelers to answer trouble beyond the outpost’s stockades.

sections.title: Savannah Hazards
sections.body: Gazrog’s watch extends across trails where raptors prey on travelers and quilboar clans ambush scouts. He coordinates responses to highway robberies, including the recovery of stolen Horde shipments. He also keeps track of missing soldiers, among them the grunt Dogran, who is injured and held by the quilboar.

faq.answer: Gazrog can be found at the Crossroads, where the Barrens’ northern, southern, and eastern routes meet.

faq.q: What role does Gazrog play for the Horde?
faq.answer: Gazrog coordinates operations and guards the Crossroads. He directs Horde travelers to protect supply lines, recover stolen shipments, and search for missing personnel.

faq.q: What happened to the stolen silver Gazrog asks about?
faq.answer: Raptors and opportunists on the Barrens trails often target Horde coin convoys. Gazrog sends champions after the beasts to recover the stolen cargo.

Dogran is a Horde grunt posted to the Crossroads to work with Gazrog. Gazrog has heard that Dogran is alive, injured, and held by the quilboar, but would rather keep the news from Dogran’s mate, Zankaja.

faq.q: Is Gazrog affiliated with Ratchet or the goblins?
faq.answer: Gazrog serves the Horde from the Crossroads. He maintains security for orc, tauren, and troll interests across the central Barrens.

faq.q: Why are raptors stealing supplies in the Barrens?
faq.answer: No one knows why the raptors steal supplies. They hid the silver in nests at the Raptor Grounds south of Ratchet, and Gazrog wonders if the stories of their intelligence are true.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler leaving Durotar or Mulgore, you can find work with Gazrog to secure travel routes across Kalimdor.
As an orc, you know Gazrog as a veteran holding the Crossroads, where keeping the frontier safe takes grit and resolve.
